hero.title.2: I develop for the web, from front end to back end
hero.title.3: And this is some of what I've built
sobre.texto.1: I'm in the second semester of Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec Jacareí. I'm looking for my first opportunity in the field while I keep building projects and improving what I already know.
sobre.texto.2: So far, most of my experience has come from personal projects, college work and hackathons. That's where I mainly use JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL and work through everything from the interface to the database.
sobre.texto.3: I learn best when I have something to build. I like tracking down bugs, organizing ideas and sharing what I learn with the people I'm working with.
info.formacao.texto: I'm in the second semester of Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec Jacareí.
info.foco.texto: Right now, I'm focused on full-stack development. I'm also starting to study cybersecurity and artificial intelligence.
info.hobbies.texto: I play drums, watch anime and enjoy competitive games. I'm also an altar server at my local parish and really enjoy cars and sport motorcycles.
